q.en: Sara has 8 apples and gets 5 more. How many apples now?
q.ar: مع سارة ٨ تفاحات وحصلت على ٥ أخرى. كم تفاحة معها الآن؟

q.en: There are 15 birds. 6 fly away. How many are left?
A spider has 8 legs. How many legs do 2 spiders have?
You have 20 stickers and give 7 to a friend. How many are left?
q.ar: معك ٢٠ ملصقًا وأعطيت صديقك ٧. كم بقي؟

q.en: 3 boxes have 5 crayons each. How many crayons in total?
q.ar: في ٣ علب ٥ أقلام تلوين في كل منها. كم قلمًا في المجموع؟

q.en: How many days are in one week?
A triangle has 3 corners. How many corners do 4 triangles have?
q.ar: للمثلث ٣ زوايا. كم زاوية لأربعة مثلثات؟

q.en: How many sides does a square have? ⬛
How many sides does a triangle have? 🔺
How many wheels does a bike have? 🚲
How many legs does a cat have? 🐱
How many fingers on one hand? ✋
How many wheels does a car have? 🚗
